description: This file declares the interface for a factory class that creates IMediaKeys instances for IPC in the Rialto media framework. It defines the IMediaKeysIpcFactory class with a static method to create factory instances and a pure virtual method to create IMediaKeys objects based on a key system string.

classes.name: IMediaKeysIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides methods to create IMediaKeys instances for IPC based on a key system.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Pure virtual method that creates a new IMediaKeys instance for IPC based on the provided key system string.
